en: Carry the holy sword
Emperor Dragon Descends
From "Digimon Adventure 02: Diaboromon's Counterattack", he carries the Omega Blade.
Imperialdramon Paladin mode is commercialized as Figure-rise Standard Amplified!
Reproduce the large wing and omega blade with new modeling!
◆ The large wing of Imperialdramon Paladin mode is reproduced with new modeling.
Reproduce the characteristic large wing with new modeling!
The two-tiered structure allows for wide expansion.
◆ Reproduce the coloring of Paladin mode
The black parts of the chin, abdomen, and thighs are separated into parts, and the white and gold coloring is reproduced with molding colors and seals.
◆ Newly included Omega Blade
Omegamon's transformed "Omega Blade" is reproduced with a new model.
The blade part is made of PETSeal, and the center jewel is made of jewel seal. The blue line is reproduced by dividing the parts.
◆ Delivered in full color PKG!
